Web check of 2026-07-27. No establishment retained, and no candidate of any kind was identified: the search returned no Icelandic training in puppetry arts, neither degree-granting nor in workshop form. Iceland has a single higher arts school, the Iceland University of the Arts, whose performing arts department was not read at source in this pass. The value of 0 is therefore kept but rests on an absence of results, which is the weakest evidentiary state in this series: finding nothing is not the same as establishing an absence. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1 to carry that weakness. Estimate.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
